summary: Execute planner task T-150 by adding read-only local compute/software capability discovery and workload readiness separate from model reasoning and repository authority.

candidates.rationale: Add a fixed allowlisted discovery boundary and named workload prerequisite resolver for CPU/GPU/software capability without arbitrary command execution.
Integrate local compute discovery into workspace/CLI/docs and full-regression scope without writing host observations into canonical policy.

applied_changes.description: Added noncanonical host discovery plus READY/BLOCKED workload resolution for NVENC, Ollama, and Python with no execution/mutation authority.
Integrated local compute protocol/policy/tool into ICM discovery, documentation, and impact classification.
